# @wthek/nestjs-middleware

> Production-safe NestJS error-handling middleware for `http-error-kit`.

## Overview
`@wthek/nestjs-middleware` provides adapter-aware error handling for NestJS applications. It inspects the underlying NestJS HTTP adapter (`express` or `fastify`) at runtime and automatically binds the corresponding engine middleware (`@wthek/express-middleware` or `@wthek/fastify-middleware`).

## Installation
```bash
npm install @wthek/nestjs-middleware http-error-kit http-response-status-code
```

## Quick Start
```typescript
import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
import { AppModule } from "./app.module";
import { KitNestJsMiddleware } from "@wthek/nestjs-middleware";
import { BadRequestError, NotFoundError } from "http-error-kit";

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);

  // Automatically detects Express or Fastify adapter
  KitNestJsMiddleware(app, { log: true, handleUnknownErrors: true });

  await app.listen(3000);
}
bootstrap();
```

## Throwing Errors in NestJS Controllers
```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Param } from "@nestjs/common";
import { NotFoundError, BadRequestError } from "http-error-kit";

@Controller("users")
export class UsersController {
  @Get(":id")
  findOne(@Param("id") id: string) {
    if (!id) {
      throw new BadRequestError("User ID must not be empty");
    }
    throw new NotFoundError("User not found", { id });
  }
}
```

## API Reference

### `KitNestJsMiddleware(app: INestApplication, options?: IKitNestJsMiddlewareOptions)`
Detects `app.getHttpAdapter().getType()` and registers the appropriate middleware:
- For `"express"`: registers `app.use(KitExpressMiddleware(options))`
- For `"fastify"`: registers `KitFastifyMiddleware(adapter.getInstance(), options)`
- Throws an error for unsupported HTTP adapters.

#### Options (`IKitNestJsMiddlewareOptions`)
- `log` (`boolean | ((error: unknown, req: unknown) => void)`, default: `false`):
  Logs error via `console.error` (Express) or `request.log.error` (Fastify Pino), or passes to custom logger callback.
- `handleUnknownErrors` (`boolean`, default: `false`):
  When `true`, catches non-Kit errors and returns a structured 500 JSON response instead of the framework default.

## Safety Rules for AI Agents
1. Call `KitNestJsMiddleware(app)` inside `bootstrap()` immediately after creating the NestJS app instance.
2. Throw errors directly from `http-error-kit` (e.g., `throw new NotFoundError(...)`) inside NestJS controllers, services, or guards.
3. NestJS exception filters can coexist; `KitNestJsMiddleware` handles uncaught errors reaching the HTTP adapter layer.
